description:
Install the independently derived rank-one digit value and native-BOS frame.

Only layer3 V and four arithmetic Up rows change. All programme gates, Down
columns, normalization gains and other native weights remain exact. The
analysis uses actual recorded attention mixtures and individual source-token
constraints; it contains no answer targets or nonlinear replay.

extra.constant_reference: Native residual head means including fixed BOS

analysis.target: One current-token digit code; four native residual head means supply the reference constant.
analysis.source_probe_limitation: Older A39 prefix and syntax activations; complete current-circuit verification required.

extra.format_caveat: Older individual-source probes and dominant-branch algebra require official current-circuit verification.
extra.native_input_provenance: Every layer0..3 weight matches A117 baseline used by the A119 recorded mixtures.
